history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration develop overarching guidance on the use of general temporary assistance, in which its definition, budgeting, establishment, duration, review and reporting, reclassification and conversion, among others, are stipulated clearly.
history.administration_response: The proposed programme budget for 2024 expanded the definitions (A/78/6 (Introduction), annex II) to also cover and distinguish the different types of positions, with the intent of addressing this recommendation from the Board. The proposed programme budget for 2025 continues to include definitions of the different types of positions. This is aimed at ensuring consistency in the use of the different types of positions, including general temporary assistance positions. In addition, information on the delegation of authority for heads of entities on the establishment, abolishment, and reclassification of general temporary assistance positions is provided on the Secretariat’s Knowledge Gateway SharePoint site for easy reference. The Administration considers this recommendation fully implemented and respectfully requests its closure.
history.board_assessment: Given that the auditors found that some similar issues still existed in the 2023 United Nations Secretariat Interim Audit, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration develop overarching guidance on the use of general temporary assistance, in which its definition, budgeting, establishment, duration, review and reporting, reclassification and conversion, among others, are stipulated clearly.
history.administration_response: Programme Planning and Budget Division: The Administration had already considered this recommendation to be implemented on the basis of the updated guidance of the Office of Human Resources, and had requested that the recommendation be closed. The Programme Planning and Budget Division will further enhance the guidelines on the use of general temporary assistance in the budget guide on the formulation of the proposed programme budget for 2026 and will request closure on that basis. The Administration wishes to further discuss with the Board the criteria for the closure of this recommendation in order to ensure that the recommendation can be considered as having been addressed in the 2024 financial year.
history.board_assessment: Given that the guidance has been updated, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
